idea-plugin.name: Kei - API Contract Testing
idea-plugin.description:
Real-Time API Contract Testing in Your IDE

Kei validates your API calls against OpenAPI and GraphQL contracts as you type. Breaking changes show up as inline warnings — not as production incidents. Works with TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, and Kotlin.

Contract Discovery

  • Automatic detection of OpenAPI (v2/v3) and GraphQL schemas
  • Supports local files, remote URLs, and schema registries
  • Contract Explorer panel with a tree view of all endpoints and types

Real-Time Validation

  • Validates every API call against its contract in under 50ms
  • Inline red underlines for contract violations — just like compiler errors
  • Breaking change detection with severity levels (critical, warning, info)
  • Side-by-side contract diff viewer for comparing schema versions

Quick Fixes and Refactoring

  • Press Alt+Enter on any violation for smart fix suggestions
  • Auto-rename fields, update types, and add missing parameters
  • One-click mock server generation from any contract

Pro Features

  • Analytics dashboard — track contract health and violation trends
  • Version management — pin, compare, and roll back contract versions
  • Advanced mocking — custom rules, delays, and error simulation
  • Test generation — auto-generate contract tests from schemas

Team / Enterprise Features

  • Security analyzer for API contract patterns
  • AI-powered contract suggestions and improvements
  • Team collaboration with shared registries and review workflows
  • CI/CD integration for pipeline-level contract validation

Pricing

Free Pro Team / Enterprise
Contract discovery, real-time validation, inline warnings, quick fixes, contract explorer, breaking change detection, mock server Everything in Free plus analytics dashboard, version management, advanced mocking, and test generation — $9/month per user Everything in Pro plus security analyzer, AI features, team collaboration, and CI/CD integration — contact us

Requirements

  • JDK 17 or later
  • IntelliJ IDEA 2023.1+ (or compatible JetBrains IDE)

Support

  • Documentation
  • Issue Tracker (GitHub)
  • Community Forum
  • Email Support (Pro and Team)
idea-plugin.change-notes:
What's New

  • Automatic Contract Discovery - Detects OpenAPI and GraphQL specs in your project automatically
  • Real-Time Validation - Inline warnings when code diverges from your API contract in under 50ms
  • Breaking Change Detection - Highlights backward-incompatible API changes with severity levels
  • Smart Quick Fixes - Auto-generate code stubs and fix type mismatches with Alt+Enter
  • Contract Explorer - Tree view of all API contracts with endpoints and schema details
  • Contract Diff Viewer - Side-by-side comparison of contract versions to track changes
  • Multi-Language Support - Works with TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, and Kotlin
  • Mock Server Generation - One-click mock server from your API contracts
  • Test Generation - Auto-generate test suites from contract definitions (Pro)
